ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - CoercedPotato Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of CoercedPotato, a tool for privilege escalation

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\CoercedPotato\\\.exe$") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-exploitId\\ .*") OR (process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=A75D7669DB6B2E107A44C4057FF7F7D6.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=F91624350E2C678C5DCBE5E1F24E22C9.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=14C81850A079A87E83D50CA41C709A15.*")))
